method: Equal-weight acceptance units. Only verified behavior counts. Source-only implementation, partial and pending work remain open. This is requirement acceptance coverage, not a time estimate or final release-readiness score. Each unit includes every feature named in that row. Parent axes close only when every unit and final gates pass.

states.verified: Implemented with matching behavioral evidence for this unit; broader native/visual/performance checks are separately listed.
states.implemented: Code present; matching current acceptance incomplete.
states.partial: Functionality or required integration still missing.
states.pending: Required implementation or acceptance activity not completed.
